# Not a single one of the SPA's own files loaded, so no script ever ran and no API call
# was ever attempted. #root stayed empty; the accessibility snapshot of the page is empty.
#
# The 404s are at the CommandMate ROOT, not under /proxy/oc/: the shell's `<script src>` and
# `<link href>` are absolute (`/assets/...`), so the browser resolves them against the ORIGIN,
# discarding the /proxy/oc/ mount point. Frames 5-7 are CommandMate's own Next.js assets,
# which is what /assets/... would have to collide with if it were ever mounted at the root.
